text: Okay, so for those who didn't quite understand what is going on, this video is implying that when it comes to dancing, men tend to over-sexualize it, while women tend to keep it modest. Essentially, blaming men for yet another thing. And this is just so untrue. Probably very few of you know this, but dancing is actually one of my main hobbies. I have been dancing hip-hop for quite a few years. I am by no means a pro, but I dance at a decent amateur level. And most importantly, I know the dance scene from the inside. First of all, dancing is one of those fields where women massively outnumber men. If a class has 20-30% guys, that is already considered good, and a good portion of the guys who do dancing are gay. And second, out of all the dance styles, hip-hop, reggaeton, contemporary, female, you know which ones are the most sexualized? It is heels and pole dance classes. By a huge margin. And these classes normally have no straight dudes at all. There is even a joke in the dancing community, do you know how to spot the teacher in a heels class? It is the girl wearing the least amount of clothes. So again, do men sexualize women? For sure we do. I am not saying we don't. But you know who sexualizes women much more than men, at least when it comes to dancing? It is women themselves. Men don't even come close. So the next time you want to come up with yet another reason to blame men, at least use some critical thinking and pick an example that is not so obviously false.
